window: Past 24 hours, with search-index lag: two Asia/Africa seizures from earlier in November surfaced as new. Searches across US federal, local US, South American and military counter-narcotics sources found nothing new and verifiable; the latest SOUTHCOM strike found was dated Oct 27 and is already logged.

stories.headline: Kenyan police seize 454 kg of suspected methamphetamine in Kwale County after a cross-border handover from Tanzania
stories.body: A suspect stopped in Tanzania on 5 November was passed to Kenyan police at the Lungalunga-Horohoro crossing, and investigators then traced the drugs to Kinondo in Kwale County. Three people were arrested, and two cars and a motorcycle were impounded; police put the street value at Ksh3.6 billion.

stories.headline: Philippine police and PDEA recover 67 kg of shabu in Zamboanga City buy-bust, four held
stories.body: On 11 November, a joint PNP-PDEA team in Barangay Mercedes recovered about 2 kg during a sting, and a follow-up search of the area turned up another 65 kg. Four suspects were arrested; the operation was code-named Coplan Shadow Ice and officials valued the haul at P455.6 million.
